ARREST OF ARMED PLAINCLOTHES SOLDIER ON BRENNAN ROAD, O.O.

At 10.30a.m. 12.9.37 Yung Wei Fang was taken to the
office of Supt.MacDermott P.A./D.C.(Crime) and at 12.20pm
handed over to Chief Inspector Yang Foong Kyi(楊鳳岐
of the Martial Office of the Shanghai Woosung Garrison
Headquarters.

C.I.Yang and Yung Wei Fang left Police H.Q. in a
Johnson hire car S.M.C.No.18401.
Attached:- C.I.Yang's letter of introduction from the
Martial Office of the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison.

静安寺巡捕房报告第255/37号。        静安寺
                       1937年9月12日
2.

上午10时30分至下午12时30分         助理总监/副总监（刑事）办公室
                               总部

在越界筑路区布伦南路逮捕一名持枪便衣士兵。

1937年9月12日上午10时30分，雍伟芳（Yung Wei Fang）被带至助理总监/副总监（刑事）麦克德莫特警司（Supt. MacDermott）的办公室，并于下午12时20分移交给上海吴淞戒严司令部军法处杨凤岐总督察（Chief Inspector Yang Foong Kyi）。

杨总督察与雍伟芳乘坐一辆约翰逊出租车（上海公共租界车牌号18401）离开警察总部。
附件：上海吴淞戒严司令部军法处出具的杨总督察介绍信。

Special Branch

BUBBLING WELL 80379
Sept 11th / 37

JEWELRY OF DISTRICTS

D.A. Room

At 2.50 p.m. 10-9-37 P.C. Mills & A.I. Man a barrier det.
at Brenan Road received information that male Chinese in plain
clothes had a pistol.

This man was arrested by the above officers and found to be
in possession of a "Mauser" pistol, 2 magazines & 30 rounds of
ammunition.

His name was ascertained to be Yung of Fang, a member of
the Special Service Corps, he was taken to the Special Branch
and questioned after which he was detained for further enquiries.
Pistol to Headquarters for disposal.

Please see Station Reference No. 255/37.

Between 11.30 p.m. 10-9-37 & 5.30 a.m. 11-9-37 various
patrols operated in Bubbling Well District enforcing "Curfew".

Two male foreigners, 7 male & 2 female Chinese were arrested
and detained until 5 a.m. 11-9-37 with the exception of one male
foreigner who was escorted home.

A.I. Szalay & 8 Constables, S.S.C. (Special) assisted in
the curfew patrols.

（左侧手写批注：* See also D 829A/9 (PRd. Min. 150/37) re activities of members of.）

静安寺 80379
1937年9月11日

各区珠宝案

侦探助理办公室

1937年9月10日下午2时50分，米尔斯巡警（P.C. Mills）和曼探员（A.I. Man）——布伦南路路障执勤人员——接到情报，称有一名身穿便衣的中国男子持有手枪。

该男子被上述警员逮捕，经查实其持有一支“毛瑟”手枪、2个弹匣及30发子弹。

查明其姓名为雍伟芳（Yung of Fang），系特别服务队成员，他被带至特科接受讯问，随后被拘留以待进一步调查。
手枪送交总部处理。

请参阅巡捕房参考编号 255/37。

1937年9月10日晚上11时30分至1937年9月11日凌晨5时30分之间，静安寺区开展了各项巡逻行动，执行“宵禁”。

两名外籍男性、七名中国男性及两名中国女性被逮捕并拘留至1937年9月11日凌晨5时，其中一名外籍男性由警员护送回家。

萨拉伊探员（A.I. Szalay）及8名特别服务队（特别组）警员协助进行了宵禁巡逻。

（左侧手写批注：* 另见 D 829A/9（PRd. Min. 150/37），关于成员活动事宜。）
